# QnALog 1.7.6

Find words in a recording, see the status of each decision, and review to-dos from all notes in one place.

## Added

- **Find in recording.** A search field under the sidebar player lists the sentences that contain your words, with time, speaker and the matching text highlighted. Click a result to play from that moment. Several words must all appear in the same sentence; Chinese numerals and digits match each other (十一 / 11, 百分之十五 / 15%); a speaker's name lists what they said. The search runs locally on the transcript. Also available as the command **Find in the current note's recording**.
- **Decision status, owners and due dates.** In the "Where decisions and actions were said" section, each decision now shows whether it was confirmed, proposed, disputed, left open, or replaced by a later decision (with a pointer to the new one). Action items show the owner, the due date as it was said, and whether the owner explicitly accepted. When unsure, the plugin keeps the weaker status rather than marking a decision as confirmed. The organized text itself is unchanged.
- **To-do summary.** A view in the main area lists the tasks from all QnALog notes, with owner, due date, source note and a link to the moment it was said. Group by note or by owner, and filter by open or done, owner and due date. Click a task to open its note at that line. You can tick a task in the summary; the plugin first checks that the line in the note has not changed, and it does not tick tasks inside a note's saved-version section (open the note to tick those). Open it from the new icon in the sidebar header or the command **Open to-do summary**. Completion is read only from the checkboxes in your notes; no task files are created.

## Known issue

- A task ticked in a note returns to unticked after **Reorganize** or after switching to another saved version of that note, because both rewrite the note's text. The earlier version is kept in the note's version history. A fix is planned for the next release.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. No settings are dropped or changed by the upgrade.
- No need to reconfigure services or API keys.
- Existing notes are not rewritten by the upgrade. Decision statuses appear in notes organized or reorganized with 1.7.6; older notes keep their sources section without statuses.
- Notes organized with 1.7.6 store decision data in a newer format. If you go back to 1.7.5 or earlier, those notes still open normally, but their sources section is not shown until they are organized again.
- Not yet verified on mobile.
